I confirmed Ilse's note in our direct message. I told them their Quarrendon Freight Lines paperwork cutoff is now 7 July and that it stays between the two of us.

I didn't save the date to the shared knowledge base, because other members can read it there. That means the date only exists in this DM, so I'd have to come back here to find it later.

My first attempt went to the wrong place: I used the DM channel id as a person and the message wasn't delivered. I re-sent it to the DM itself and it arrived. I took no other action, as Ilse asked.
